editorial:
Imagine a couple that takes their dares way too far. You get Jill and Ian, two artists who love pushing limits. He is a filmmaker and she is an artist, and they spend their time filming their wild adventures. The vibe starts off as a risky romance, but it turns into a total nightmare when they decide to visit an old, creepy abandoned hospital. Ian thinks it would be a funny prank to strap Jill to a gurney and leave her alone for a bit, but he accidentally wakes up something evil that lived in the building. It is a shaky-cam style movie that makes you feel like you are right there in the room with them as things go south.

The acting feels natural, and the tension builds up well before the scary parts hit. One big pro is how it mixes romance with real scares, though the found-footage style might make you dizzy if you are sensitive to that. If you enjoy movies where characters make bad choices, you will love this one. It is a great pick for a late-night movie marathon with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a scary twist involving the entity from the hospital. After a lot of chaos, the evil spirit manages to take over Jill's body completely. You see that the thing inside her is not gone; it has just found a new way to move around. The final scenes show that the horror didn't stay in the hospital. Instead, it followed them home, leaving you with the chilling feeling that the monster has won.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves found-footage horror and supernatural twists.
